title: A broadcast challenge and its rebroadcast — Newman
shortTitle: A broadcast challenge and its rebroadcast — Newman
summary: A reward-like challenge tied to calling during a particular program is later heard through a rebroadcast.
notes: Did the later transmission repeat a continuing offer, create a new one, or merely report an expired challenge? How should the stated time and program context control?
